name: Marketing TRIZ
description: Same TRIZ machinery with marketing / growth vocabulary — funnels, campaigns, conversion, audience, positioning.

parameter_map.Speed: campaign launch time / time-to-market / growth velocity
parameter_map.Object-generated harmful factors: brand dilution / ad fatigue / spam complaints
parameter_map.Loss of substance: wasted ad spend / burn rate on unproven channels

principle_soft.1: segment the audience; modular campaigns you can A/B independently
principle_soft.2: remove the annoying step from the funnel (the required sign-up)
principle_soft.5: combine channels — bundle offers, cross-promote across touchpoints
principle_soft.6: one campaign that serves many segments (evergreen content repurposed)
principle_soft.10: pre-launch teasers; nurture the audience before the offer drops
principle_soft.15: dynamic pricing; adaptive creative rotation by audience response
principle_soft.32: change the visual frame — reframe perception, not just the message

examples: The landing page must convert more visitors, but adding friction to capture data hurts sign-ups.
Growth must accelerate, but ad spend on new channels is burning cash without proven ROI.
